jobs.name: ig7_cover
jobs.person_note: The woman must be exactly the woman from the attached photo (same face, dark hair in a low bun, thin gold round glasses, camel blazer, cream blouse).
jobs.style: A finished, eye-catching vertical Instagram Reels COVER in the look of a calm, premium documentary-interview thumbnail: a photorealistic close-up frame of exactly the woman from the attached photo against the same bare warm light-grey plaster wall with a soft window shadow, natural light. Bold, clean, perfectly spelled Russian typography is REQUIRED and is the only text: an elegant italic serif title in a white box, black text, in three lines «36 вопросов,» / «после которых» / «становятся близкими», with the number «36» much larger. No other words, no logos, no watermarks, no UI elements, no handles. High contrast, readable at small size in the profile grid.
jobs.style_qa: обложка-кадр интервью, ведущая из приложенного фото узнаваема и не искажена, надпись «36 вопросов, после которых становятся близкими» без ошибок, другого текста и логотипов нет
jobs.prompt: Vertical 9:16. The woman from the chest up in the lower 60% of the frame, centred, looking slightly off-camera with a calm, warm expression. The title sits in the upper part, centred, starting about 18% below the top edge and inside the central 4:5 safe area so it is not cropped in the profile grid; the title never covers her face.
